mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting to an easing stance, lowering discount rates and boosting equity present value, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in easing regimes are not statistically higher than in neutral regimes (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5% signals tightening monetary policy, raising discount rates and compressing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns in tightening regimes are not significantly lower than in neutral regimes (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 100,000 indicates a strengthening labor market, prompting firms to expand capital spending and boost equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in strengthening labor regimes are not statistically higher than in neutral regimes (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in monthly employment growth below 50,000 signals labor market weakness, prompting firms to conserve capital and reduce equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns in weakening labor regimes are not significantly lower than in neutral regimes (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 120 indicates expanding domestic demand, prompting firms to ramp up capital expenditures and boost equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in expanding demand regimes are not statistically higher than in neutral regimes (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals contracting domestic demand, prompting firms to conserve capital and reduce equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns in contracting demand regimes are not significantly lower than in neutral regimes (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in CPIAUCSL above 0.2% indicates accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to raise rates, which compresses discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in accelerating inflation regimes are not significantly lower than in neutral regimes (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 0.2% combined with a sustained monthly decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4% signals a robust labor market and inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to raise rates, which compresses discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: robust labor market and inflationary pressures
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns in robust labor market inflation regimes are not significantly lower than in neutral regimes (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
